Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies (servers, networking, databases), and cloud platforms & application development Experience in Linux/Unix/Windows Administration, AD, SAML, SSO, MFA Experience in network/firewall/load balancer design and implementation.( LDAP, TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP, HTTPS, APIs) Experience with service management methodologies and tools like ServiceNow. Excellent problem solving, communication & Interpersonal skills interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, build relationship & collaborate with diverse teams. Highly organized, analytical, and procedural with creative and strategic thinking. Adept at managing multiple projects and meeting tight deadlines. Passionate about solution development and automation, actively seeking opportunities to develop tools that streamline and simplify development and delivery processes. Key Responsibilities: 1. Technical Design and Architecture: Design and implement end-to-end systems and solutions for managing IT infrastructure and automating IT managed service delivery. System design should encompass understanding of network, servers (physical and virtual),Interfaces, integration, applications, Data flows, security, and operations. Ensure adherence of best practices and security standards. Reviews the firewall sheets, monitoring configuration sheets and propose changes. Should understand and drive the operations of existing Integrated Application landscape which has for example SAP, Concur, HCM, Vendor Invoice Management System, Service Now etc. 2. Drive Project & Requirement Understand the Technical, Functional and non-functional requirements. Assess the technical feasibility, impact on the infrastructure & identify potential bottlenecks and risks. Foster a high-performing team environment by removing technical roadblocks and guiding team members towards optimal performance. Drive project schedules, deliverables & collaborate with cross-IT teams for implementing IT, Infra and service management solutions. 3. Capacity Planning and Performance Tuning: Estimate resource requirements (CPU, memory, disk, network). Monitor system performance and identify optimization opportunities. Implement performance tuning techniques improve response times and throughput. Ensure efficient use of infrastructure resources support application performance. 4. Problem solver: Detect and diagnose issues that arise at the intersection of application and infrastructure. Work with both teams to develop and implement solutions to these issues. Identify opportunities to optimize the performance of applications through infrastructure improvements. 5. Change Management and Deployment: Oversee application deployments and upgrades. Manage change requests and assess their impact on the infrastructure. Provide management summary for CAB. Coordinate with infrastructure teams to schedule and execute deployments. Excellent problem solving, communication & Interpersonal skills interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, build relationship & collaborate with diverse teams. Highly organized, analytical, and procedural with creative and strategic thinking. Adept at managing multiple projects and meeting tight deadlines.
